[Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college)

## Appearance

Phil Gordon possesses distinct brown tints to her appearance. On her wedding day, she presented the look of a dainty fairy of a bride.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Phil Gordon presents a frivolous exterior, though she is truly a loyal, sweet, and goodhearted person at heart who lacks snobbishness. She has learned practical skills such as washing dishes and sweeping floors. Additionally, she harbors a deep dread of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## History

Philippa Gordon, the daughter of a prominent man from a [Bluenose](../codex/factions.md#bluenose) family in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while exploring Old St. John's Cemetery near [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She quickly adopted them into her social circle and eventually persuaded them to let her join their household at Patty's Place. While spending a summer at a boardinghouse, Phil met a divinity student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), whose sermon deeply moved her and inspired feelings of love. She later accepted Jonas's marriage proposal and shared the news with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After graduating from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Phil comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected Royal Gardner's marriage proposal. Phil subsequently married [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serving as her bridesmaid. Years later, Phil returned to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as a guest to attend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's wedding.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P5](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0005), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), +26 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ll go, if I can walk with Priscilla and Charlie. That will be a bearable degree of gooseberry. That Gilbert of yours is a darling, Anne, but why does he go around so much with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "I don’t want William’s Island especially, but I’m sure I couldn’t get it if I did. Look at that sentry on the summit of the fort, right beside the flag. Doesn’t he look as if he had stepped out of a romance?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P25](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0025)

> "Look—in white letters, around the archway over the gate. ‘Patty’s Place.’ Isn’t that killing? Especially on this Avenue of Pinehursts and Elmwolds and Cedarcrofts? ‘Patty’s Place,’ if you please! I adore it."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

> "Joseph, you calico beastie, don’t you dare jump on my lap. I won’t go to a dance all over cat hairs. No, Anne, I won’t look matronly. But no doubt I’ll be married."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Interlude P18](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0018)

> "No, he would do if he wasn’t poor. I must marry a rich man, Aunt Jamesina. That—and good looks—is an indispensable qualification. I’d marry Gilbert Blythe if he were rich."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Interlude P30](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0030)
